sw.tutorial.dialog.2: Next, I'll explain how to play this game.
sw.tutorial.dialog.4: You will be spread across the Overworld according to your teams.
sw.tutorial.dialog.5: You will then have 10 minutes to gather resources.
sw.tutorial.dialog.6: Gather as many resources as possible.
sw.tutorial.dialog.8: When time is up, you will be teleported to the arena.
sw.tutorial.dialog.10: You will have 3 minutes to fight.
sw.tutorial.dialog.12: In short... think of it as a large-scale Walls game.
sw.tutorial.dialog.13: Since I developed all the programming myself...
sw.tutorial.dialog.14: there may be a few bugs...
sw.tutorial.dialog.15: If you find a bug, feel free to report it to me!
